sentences.en: Many people, especially in small countries like Sweden, indulge in what might be called a fetishism of the UNO.

sentences.en: Thus in the varied manifestations of law Vico was able to discover a single and enduring principle (De universi juris uno princ p peo et fine uno).

sentences.en: Favoured over numero uno y dos by many fans, Sonic 3 is the deepest game in the series so far.

sentences.en: This VoIP cellular phone service is offered by T-Mobile in the United States (branded as T-Mobile HotSpot@Home) and by Fido in Canada (branded as UNO).

sentences.en: At the family card table, you can also amp up your fun with a card game designed for every family member like Uno Attack or Apples to Apples.

sentences.en: When you play Uno Online, you have the choice of two playing modes, playing a single hand or playing against four other players.
sentences.vi: Khi bạn chơi Uno Online, bạn có thể lựa chọn hai chế độ chơi, chơi một tay hoặc chơi với bốn người chơi khác.

sentences.en: You play Uno Online the same way you play the actual card game Uno.
sentences.vi: Bạn chơi Uno Online giống như cách bạn chơi trò chơi bài Uno thực tế.
